name: aeroguardian-ai
description: AeroGuardian AI - Pilot Workload & Decision Support System

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); if(!fs.existsSync('public/static')) fs.mkdirSync('public/static', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'public/index.html'); fs.cpSync('static', 'public/static', {recursive:true}); console.log('Static assets synced to public/');"
